card.title: Waiting for the Bad News
card.instruction: Treat pauses, changes, and uncertainty as signs that rejection or loss is approaching, then prepare yourself before it arrives.

transfer.action: I prepare an empty packing box beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: Better to be ready for the bad part. {request}
transfer.response: That pause sounds like the start of a goodbye. {counter}
transfer.challenge: You haven't heard the news yet.
transfer.closing: Exactly. This is my last chance to brace before knowing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've brought a rejection box to our application meeting. Help me choose celebration glasses too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You think we'll be rejected?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm prepared. I'd like you to prepare the other possibility beside me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Two glasses, then.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Keep them where I can see them over the box.

bespokePairs.seedUse: Uses S111-single-a's anticipatory packing box and D103-single-b's application and celebration glasses. A1 combines feared rejection with a request for hopeful preparation; A3 uses B2's doubt to recruit the other possibility, and A5 places B4's two glasses above the box. The application meeting adapts the Stance seed's workplace uncertainty. These are source contributions, not an individual pair review.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They paused before announcing the result. Draw a hopeful second route with me before the bad news.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A pause doesn't mean bad news.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then hold the other pencil while I try believing that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We could still get in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Write that first, before I make room for what scares me.

bespokePairs.seedUse: Uses S111-single-b's pause interpreted as approaching loss and D103-single-a's hopeful route and two pencils. A1 asks for an alternative before bad news; A3 gives B a pencil after B2 challenges the inference, and A5 uses B4's possibility of admission as the first thing to write. The admissions result is this pair's setting, not the dinner in the Stance seed. Pair semantic review remains pending.

card.title: Waiting for the Bad News
card.instruction: Treat pauses, changes, and uncertainty as signs that rejection or loss is approaching, then prepare yourself before it arrives.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've brought a box to the meeting. Is this where you dismiss me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We want to discuss your promotion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Promotion to what? The box is very adaptable.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: More responsibility.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. I'll keep it for the mistakes.

card.title: Hope with Me
card.instruction: Recruit someone into believing that the outcome can still change, even when the evidence is thin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Draw another route with me. The first two failed, but we're not finished.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The third might fail too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I need two pencils facing it, not one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Where do we start?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At the bit we still want.

card.title: Waiting for the Bad News
card.instruction: Treat pauses, changes, and uncertainty as signs that rejection or loss is approaching, then prepare yourself before it arrives.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You paused before answering. Shall I brace for goodbye?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was swallowing tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: People prepare their throats for difficult news.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm asking you to dinner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One last dinner, or may I leave the box at home?

card.title: Hope with Me
card.instruction: Recruit someone into believing that the outcome can still change, even when the evidence is thin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Help me choose the glasses for the celebration if the application works.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We haven't heard back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know. I don't want to hope at an empty place setting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Two glasses, then?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. That's a future I can look at.

card.title: Waiting for the Bad News
card.instruction: Treat pauses, changes, and uncertainty as signs that rejection or loss is approaching, then prepare yourself before it arrives.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You moved our meeting to Friday. I've brought a box for my desk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a promotion. You'll manage the new branch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Away from everyone? I'll pack before they have to say goodbye.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can still come to Friday drinks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll bring my own glass. Better get used to being a visitor before they stop inviting me.

card.title: Waiting for the Bad News
card.instruction: Treat pauses, changes, and uncertainty as signs that rejection or loss is approaching, then prepare yourself before it arrives.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You paused when I asked about Saturday. Should I collect my things from your flat?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was swallowing tea. I'm taking you to dinner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Somewhere public. I'll bring tissues that fit in my sleeve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's at home. I'm cooking your favourite.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll bring containers. You shouldn't have my leftovers haunting the fridge afterwards.
